$comment: Reviewed findings from tools/validate-shared-component-claims.mjs. Every entry needs a written reason of at least 40 characters, and an entry whose finding no longer fires must be deleted rather than left as stale absolution.

reviewed.text: Found the volume instead of the surface area
reviewed.reason: This is a misconception LABEL, not instruction. It names an error a student made — computing volume when the question asked for surface area — and is only ever shown attached to a tagged response on a lesson that teaches both. It teaches nobody a contrast; it describes one student's work.

reviewed.text: ["a lesson label", "In Lesson 1-1 you estimated the Ferris wheel: 20 cars each holding about 4 people. About how many riders was that?"],
reviewed.reason: This is a TEST FIXTURE, not a claim the engine makes to a student. The string is quoted verbatim from lesson 10-6's own authored practice stem, and the test's whole purpose is to assert that the regenerator REFUSES it — 'In Lesson 1-1' was being rewritten as arithmetic into 'In Lesson 95 - 11'. Removing the lesson label would remove the thing under test.

This is a TEST FIXTURE inside a unit test, never rendered to a student. It models one asset row of a lesson-3-3 coverage entry so the test can assert how the publisher-upgrade engine groups assets; the lesson label matches the fixture's own /lessons/3-3/ path, so nothing claims another lesson's identity.
